Context: This update looks at Ethnic Wear revenue in June vs. May. Any month-on-month change above 8.0% in either direction is reviewed.
Insight: [Fact] Ethnic Wear revenue fell from INR 185,107.61 in May to INR 76,371.53 in June, a change of -58.74%. [Fact] Orders went from 104 to 52 over the same period.
Implication: [Hypothesis] The fall may be the May demand driver ending, rather than a new weakness, because orders and revenue moved together; the figures alone do not show why. [Action] Ask the regional leads whether the May Ethnic Wear promotion or seasonal demand ended, and whether any June stock shortage held back Ethnic Wear orders. [Action] Compare June's Ethnic Wear orders with May's region by region: a drop concentrated in one region points to a local problem to fix, while an even drop points to a change in demand.

Context: This update looks at Home & Kitchen revenue in June vs. May. Any month-on-month change above 8.0% in either direction is reviewed.
Insight: [Fact] Home & Kitchen revenue rose from INR 91,152.57 in May to INR 129,971.22 in June, a change of 42.59%. [Fact] Orders went from 44 to 73 over the same period.
Implication: [Hypothesis] The rise may reflect a June-specific demand driver, such as a promotion or seasonal push, because orders and revenue moved together; the figures alone do not show why. [Action] Ask the regional leads whether any Home & Kitchen promotion or seasonal stocking ran in June; if none did, find another explanation before June is used as a planning baseline. [Action] Split June's INR 129,971.22 by order status (delivered, returned, cancelled, pending); if delivered revenue is much lower, treat the 42.59% change as overstated.
